_why: Same contract as Muha_Meds: every field carries a source; a field with no source is null and named in `unresolved`. Extracted from Brand Context/Dialed_Health.md 2026-08-09. NOTE: this is the most claims-sensitive brand in the portfolio — more than the cannabis one.
category: clinical peptides / GLP-1 / research compounds + at-home blood-test kit

category_risk.rule: The catalog is Semaglutide + B12, Tirzepatide, 5-Amino-1MQ, Apomorphine and other research peptides — GLP-1 and prescription-adjacent territory. NO approved claims language exists anywhere in the playbook: not one sentence about what these products may be said to DO. Until the brand supplies approved claims, video copy about effects, outcomes, dosing or comparisons is categorically off-limits — visuals-only content is the safe lane.
category_risk.source: Brand Context/Dialed_Health.md:11-21 (catalog); absence of claims language: the whole document

category_risk.rule: Labels carry NO dosing line and no extra text — logo + product name only, locked since the first vial generation. This is also a content rule: never render or speak a dose.

The blood-test kit is a specimen-collection product with a 26-step approved instruction set. Instructional content must reuse the Approved/01-26 set, not re-derive medical steps. The DH specimen bag carries logo + QR and deliberately NO biohazard symbol.
Platform policy for GLP-1/peptide advertising is unknown — whether this category can run paid distribution AT ALL is an open question, same class as the unanswered cannabis-category question on Muha.
category_risk.source: unresolved — no measurement, no counsel record

naming_rules.rule: The logo layout is LOCKED and models get it wrong: 'DIALED' top-LEFT on the horizontal line, EKG spike mid-line, 'HEALTH' bottom-RIGHT under the line — offset DIAGONALLY, never centered/stacked. Early instruction graphics were REDONE over this. Pass Product Refs/Dialed Health_Logo_Updated-02.png whenever DH branding must appear.
Sister brands: Dialed Moods (canned nootropic beverages), Dialed Labs (sauna/cold-plunge). Do not blend the three.

Container shorthand is a contract: 'Vial' = glass injectable vial, black rubber cap + gold band; 'Oral Drop' = frosted dropper bottle; 'Capsule' = clear pill bottle, brushed silver cap. Each maps to a specific reference set in the SKU registry.

locked_spellings._note: gpt-image-2 sets the DIALED/HEALTH ECG lockup accurately (verified 4/4 consecutive, 2026-07-27) — it may render the whole creative. Nano Banana garbles it; composite-after for NB only.

never_write.any dosing line on a label: labels are logo + product name ONLY — locked
never_write.a centered/stacked DIALED HEALTH lockup: the layout is offset-diagonal; centered lockups have forced redos
never_write.a biohazard symbol on the specimen bag: the approved bag carries logo + QR only (instruction step 17)

locked_visual_rules.rule: Never composite/paste product renders into scenes — regenerate in-scene with references.
Label artwork is sacred in lifestyle shots: exact from the approved studio reference, RE-LIT to the scene, never new text.
Vial upright and vertical in hand-held shots — tilt wrecks label fidelity. Realistic scale: ~2/3 the length of an index finger; oversized vials rejected.
Motion blur is CAMERA-IN-MOTION full-frame blur (subtle pan, Dutch tilt 5-8°, ~1/30s feel, 'NOTHING is rigorously tack-sharp') — never limb-localized sprinkle on a static pose.
Approved originals are style/scene anchors — copy, never move; moving them breaks the reference chain.
Lifestyle sets are a locked 6-variant spec (man/woman × gym/track/kitchen): top-down POV, ONE hand, pinch grip, 5:4, 4K. Semaglutide + B12 is the approved composition anchor.

assets_canonical._note: Approved gallery + refs; the design system is the one brand with a machine-readable one.

standing_warning.text: There is no approved claims language for any Dialed Health product. A script that says what a compound DOES is fabricating medical claims — the highest-severity version of the invented-Rolex failure. Until the brand supplies approved language in writing, DH video is visuals, brand, and instruction-set content only.
standing_warning.source: absence of claims language across Brand Context/Dialed_Health.md, checked 2026-08-09

copy_policy.may_draft: YES — for visuals-only content: studio/lifestyle shots per the locked specs, instruction-set derivatives, brand films with no effect claims. Product NAMES on labels are fine (they are the label). Spoken effect/outcome/dosing claims: NO drafting, not even with slots — there is no sourced floor to stand on.
copy_policy.must_not_state: What any compound does, doses, protocols, outcomes, comparisons, safety claims — nothing of this class exists in a sourced form.
copy_policy.unfilled_slots: Use {{SLOT: ...}} (double-BRACE) only for disclosures on otherwise claim-free content.
copy_policy.status_of_any_draft: DRAFT — NOT FOR SUBMIT until a human initials the claims list.
